description: Adaptive Surface 0.12.5 on Hytale 0.7.3: fail-closed world-pack regeneration, retained-pack recovery, unified decoration permissions and Adaptive Window placement ownership.
changes: Retain the union of saved/helper IDs, active-pack inventory and prior staged inventory at every builder entry point. Never filter away required materials missing from the catalogue.

Snapshot and preflight all material metadata, shape/model bindings and PNGs before atomic replacement. Produce actionable per-material diagnostics and suspend cache/discovery writes during fallback recovery.
Check placement versus breaking rules separately, including environment and support/occupied cells. Use cancellable native pre-events for all removal paths and reject redirected placement checks.
Keep ZMA_Window items in their native placement path and share a versioned token-to-donor index for P and Q materials.
Separate integration sources/jar, remove two synthetic catalogue materials from ordinary packaging, and audit resource preservation and provenance.
advantages: Missing/incomplete cache data cannot silently reduce a functioning pack
Previously accepted visual resources remain byte-identical
Native Window placement retains its material-selection behavior
disadvantages: No real-client visual/input acceptance or third-party region plugin certification
Legacy retained packs without donor metadata cannot restore unknown source mappings
Public release not cleared: sampled game textures, Window template provenance and project redistribution license require resolution
test_results: 279125 core assertions and distribution-exclusion checks pass against installed Hytale 0.7.3; Java 25 compilation, bundled Temurin 26.0.2 native runtime.

Actual copied cache has shared-atlas-3 and shared-atlas-4 entries; active pack has 89 materials and 2937 checked states. Missing/broken index, texture/helper loss, removed catalogue entry and legacy 0.7.2 pack fallback all retain pack bytes and load saved states.
Native ECS tests pass world/environment restrictions, support/occupied-cell cancellation, redirect rejection, Use/direct-hit/mining removal checks; no external region-protection plugin installed.
21 Window variants place through native server logic on P/Q Surface donors and persist on reopen; nine addon Secondary roots place exactly one decoration and consume once.
Four final distribution-jar boots pass native asset validation (new/copied worlds, first/reopen); plugin server SHA and package hashes recorded.
2143 resource inventory entries, 700 ordinary catalogue materials; existing models/images preserved, test components/server libraries excluded. No publishing or user-save installation.

source_refs.description: 2026-10-23 local implementation, native tests, asset provenance, residual limits; no publication or installation
